definitions: To make a complex or difficult subject clearer and easier to understand.
To remove the mystery or confusion surrounding something.
examples: The aim of the book is to demystify science for the general public.
Her lecture helped to demystify the process of applying for a grant.
We need to demystify technology so that everyone can use it effectively.
pastTenses: demystified (past simple), has/have demystified (present perfect), demystified (past perfect)
